purpose: SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-WSV1-FOLD-A-V1: SAME-FLIGHT COLUMN READ (owner decision 172; claim ceiling 'nominated', Q6 ruling). Every column -- a-base (the delivering arm's first-visit column), b-exk30 and t-twin -- is rendered from the sealed first Solver visit through the delivered row's normaliser and projection (the render refuses on any acceptance-test AT1 failure) and scored ONCE with slurp-slu-official-train through core.scoring_batch.score_complete_derived_copy; each contrast is a paired ROW bootstrap (cluster key sample_id, 10,000 draws, seed 20260928). (1) THE TWIN NULL: t-twin minus a-base on official pooled SLU-F1 (primary) and intent accuracy (guard); the bar on each metric is |twin offset| + the twin's CI95 half-width (the same law as the cross-flight in-chain A/A), reported beside the provisional floor 0.3163 pp SLU / 0.0000 pp intent (scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py, design same-flight-supply-variant: 0.735 x sqrt(200 / 1080)). (2) THE KNOB: b-exk30 minus a-base. NOMINATED iff the SLU-F1 CI95 lower bound is above zero AND the SLU-F1 point delta exceeds the twin bar AND the intent CI95 lower bound is not below minus the twin's intent bar. SOLVER-LOCAL HARM iff the SLU-F1 (or intent) CI95 upper bound is below zero and the point delta's magnitude exceeds that metric's twin bar. Otherwise NOT NOMINATED (within the twin null). A nomination claims nothing at system level: it only sends the exk30 construction to a full-system read against an in-chain A/A. The utterance-level number is reported beside the row-level one and never gates (Q4). Every verdict carries the per-scenario table in both weightings.
quality_read_gate: No column score is opened before the complete sealed manifest, the ordered outputs, the phase summary and the single complete official TRAIN score of the flight exist AND the READ row SAEA-SLURP-STAGE3-WSV1-FOLD-A-COLUMN-READ-V1 is root countersigned; each column is then scored once, never sharded.
